title: Show how many to-dos are left
description:
Below the list, show how many to-dos aren't done yet, as "3 to-dos left", or "1 to-do left" for one. Hide it when there are no to-dos at all.

## Done when

- The count updates as to-dos are added, ticked, unticked and deleted.
- It counts every to-do that isn't done, whichever filter is selected.
